name: Can't Say the Letter!
desc:
Game inspired by Can't Say the Word & Limited Words. Thanks to the developers for bringing a whole new game category to Roblox.

In this game, every player has a unique letter that they can't say. If they use the letter in message - they'll instantly get kicked. Take the risk and talk, or stay silent.

Try the same game, with different twist. Must say the word!
https://www.roblox.com/games/4644431012/
